name: peroxisome proliferator activated receptor gamma

function.text: PPARG encodes peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to lipodystrophy (semidominant); PPARG-related familial partial lipodystrophy (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Follicular thyroid carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Semidominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
